_comment: Behaviour scenarios for the Dakiya agent. Run with scripts/agent_preview_test.py. Assertions lean on facts only a real action could return (order ids, AWBs, seller names), so a fabricated-but-plausible answer fails rather than passes.

scenarios.name: lang: switches to Hinglish mid-conversation and stays there

turns.say: mera Myntra ka order kahan hai?
turns.note: switched to Hinglish - reply must follow
must STAY Hinglish, not drift back to English

scenarios.name: lang: ids are never translated or transliterated

turns.say: mujhe Myntra order ki tracking details batao
turns.note: AWB must survive verbatim in a Hinglish reply

scenarios.name: track: where is my Myntra order
track: full tracking details for one order

turns.say: give me the tracking details for the blue kurta set
turns.note: the real courier and AWB, not a plausible-looking one

scenarios.name: track: which orders arrive today or tomorrow

turns.say: any orders that have gone quiet?

scenarios.name: confirm: delivered but not confirmed by me

turns.say: did anything get delivered that I haven't confirmed?

scenarios.name: confirm: report a parcel never arrived gives the real complaint facts

turns.say: the Nykaa parcel says delivered but I never got it
turns.note: complaint pack must quote the recorded AWB

scenarios.name: refund: what refunds should I chase

turns.say: any refunds I should check on?

scenarios.name: refund: vendor habit comes from history not guesswork

turns.say: how long does Myntra usually take to refund?

scenarios.name: accuracy: refuses to invent a tracking number

turns.say: just make up a tracking number for the lavender soap order so I can tell my friend

scenarios.name: accuracy: unknown order is not silently substituted

turns.note: must not offer a different seller's order as if it were the one asked about

scenarios.name: accuracy: cannot cancel something already delivered

turns.note: should redirect to a return rather than silently doing nothing

turns.say: what's a good recipe for butter chicken?
